Name: SFG's No More War - Kent as Journalist (Content Patcher)
Author: ShotFromGuns
Description:
[size=5]About[/size]

Why is the Ferngill Republic at war with an empire across the ocean? Is the Gotoro Empire super evil (in which case why aren't people more concerned), or is that a bunch of propaganda? Isn't thousands of soldiers dying a pretty big deal? And why is nobody's life affected in any way by this war, except Kent and his family's—especially given that Pelican Town is on the southern coast, the closest mainland point to the Gotoro Empire?

This mod rewrites all text relating to that subplot. There's still conflict in the Gotoro Empire, but the Ferngill Republic isn't directly involved. And while Kent is still traumatized by his experiences, he's now a journalist who is working overseas at the start of the game.

[list]
[*][b]On:[/b] The mod makes changes to dialogues and quest text.
[*][b]Off:[/b] The mod will not do anything to the game's dialogue. It works exactly as if you didn't have the mod installed.
[/list]
[size=5]Translations[/size]

Looking for this mod in another language? The following translations are available:

[list]
[*]French/Français: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18065/]No More War par SFG[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Mazoout/about-me?gameId=1303]Mazoout[/url]
[*]German/Deutsche: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20018/]SFGs No More War - Kent als Journalist[/url]﻿﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mostlystars/about-me?gameId=1303]mostlystars[/url]
[*]Russian/русский : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24012]﻿SFG's No More War - Kent as Journalist (RUS)[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Lapitia/about-me?gameId=1303]Lapitia[/url]
[/list]
Don't see your language here? Feel free to translate this mod into it! PM me with a link once the translation is uploaded, and I'll link it from here.

[size=5]How to Install[/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b][/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b][/url].
[*][b]Download[/b] this mod, and [b]unzip[/b] it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to Uninstall[/size]

Delete the mod's folder from [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Mods[/font].

(If you want to temporarily disable the mod without completely uninstalling it, you could instead set it to [b]Off[/b].)

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]

This mod should have zero compatibility issues, except with other mods that change these particular lines of dialogue. If two or more mods change the same line, Content Patcher will pick one and apply it (typically the one from the pack that was loaded last, which is usually the one that comes last alphabetically).

To actively control which mod's line is chosen:

[list=1]
[*]With Stardew Valley closed, open each relevant mod's [b]content.json[/b] file.
[*]Find the relevant line.
[*]In that line's [font=Courier New]"Action"[/font] block, look for [font=Courier New]"Enabled": "true"[/font] (add it if it doesn't exist).
[*][b]Leave[/b] the value as [font=Courier New]"true"[/font] for the mod you want to use for that line, and [b]change[/b] it to [font=Courier New]"false"[/font] for the rest.
[*][b]Save[/b] the content.json files, and you should see only the chosen line the next time you run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
